'''Glimmerwing''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Healer]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Phosflare]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Luminastra]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "No trick of the light can deceive Glimmerwing. Appears to have little patience for humans and Tatari who get lost, but offers directions all night anyway."

Glimmerwing is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A teal blue firefly with an electrically-charged, glowing lower abdomen. Its face is light beige, and it has yellow and green antennae shaped like lightning bolts. There's a green circle on each of its wing casings which are yellow and orange at the ends.

Glimmerwing's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter Form]] changes the color of its body and irises from teal to purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Glimmerwing's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Luminastra]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Marathon Party]] (use skateboard x6000) or [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod x6000).
* Obtain 15 more Glitter Fruit. Time for a glow-up!

== Trivia ==
* Glimmerwing and its evolutions were added to the game on 7/1/2026 alongside [[Umbraveil]] and [[Hierotyrus]].
